title: Chilliwack Home Energy Rebates 2026: Heat Pumps, Insulation and Windows
desc: Chilliwack rebates for 2026 from BC Hydro, FortisBC and CleanBC, with Census numbers on Chilliwack's detached-house and owner-occupied housing.
badge: Up to $5,500 for insulation, $4,000 for a heat pump
lead: More than half of Chilliwack's 35,760 households live in a detached house, and 72% own their home. That makes this one of the best cities in the group for the home rebates, provided the house is electric.
cards_heading: What you can claim in Chilliwack in 2026
cards_intro: Amounts come from the program pages we re-read on October 2, 2026. Each card is a maximum, and most depend on how your home is heated.

cards.title: Whole-home heat pump
cards.note: Must replace electric heat such as baseboards or an electric furnace, meet 100% of the heating load at -5C and be installed by a Home Performance Contractor Network member.

cards.title: Partial heat pump
cards.note: For a heat pump that covers at least half of the heating load while replacing electric heat.

cards.title: Limited-time bonus
cards.note: Extra money on heat pump installs completed between August 1 and October 31, 2026.

cards.title: Income-qualified switch from gas, oil or propane
cards.note: CleanBC pays by income level (Level 3 / Level 2 / Level 1) for a central or three-head heat pump, for invoices from July 6, 2026.

cards.title: Insulation
cards.note: Attic, wall and basement or crawlspace work, paid per R-value added per square foot. Homes heated mainly by electricity only.

cards.title: Windows and doors
cards.note: $100 per opening, with a U-factor of 1.22 or lower.

cards.title: Heat pump water heater
cards.note: Only when it replaces an electric water heater.

cards.title: Solar panels
cards.note: $1,000 per kW, capped at half the cost, from an HPCN member installer.

cards.title: Battery storage
cards.note: Up to $1,500 on its own with solar, or up to $5,000 with Peak Saver enrolment.

cards.title: EV charger
cards.note: 50% of a new wall-mounted Level 2 charger, plus $200 for a power-management device.

sections: Why Chilliwack fits the rebate rules

The BC Hydro Home Renovation Rebates are designed around owner-occupied houses heated by electricity. In Chilliwack 54% of households live in detached houses and 72% own, so a larger share of homes can be considered than in Burnaby or Vancouver. What decides eligibility is still the heating fuel. Gas, oil and propane homes are outside the BC Hydro program unless the household qualifies for CleanBC.
Older houses are the main target

The 2021 Census puts 34% of Chilliwack households in homes built before 1981, and 6,495 of those are owner-occupied detached houses. Houses from that period often have shallow attic insulation and original windows. BC Hydro pays $0.02 per R-value added per square foot in an attic, capped at $900, and requires at least R12 added. Before you get quotes, have the contractor measure what you have now so the rebate can be calculated in advance.

About 4.6% of Chilliwack households told the Census their home needs major repairs, which is close to the middle of this group. If the roof is due anyway, ask the roofer whether attic work can be scheduled alongside it.

The January average low is 0.2°C, but the coldest recorded day in 2015 to 2024 was -17.5°C. Choose a heat pump model on BC Hydro's eligible list and make sure the installer's load calculation uses the -5°C design number the rebate requires.

claim_steps: Check if your home is mainly heated by electricity.
Measure your attic depth and walls, or ask a contractor to.
Get at least two quotes from Home Performance Contractor Network members.
If income is lower, ask about CleanBC and free upgrades first.
Apply online within six months of each invoice.
faq: Is Chilliwack eligible for BC Hydro rebates?
Yes, Chilliwack is BC Hydro electric. Eligibility then depends on how your home is heated.
Do I need an energy audit first?
BC Hydro's insulation rebate does not require one, but a contractor's measurement of what you have now helps you price the work.
What if I rent my house in Chilliwack?
The BC Hydro account holder applies, or signs a consent form. 28% of households rent.
Does Chilliwack have a local rebate on top?
We did not find one. The programs here are BC Hydro, FortisBC and CleanBC.
